fields.name: Blinded
fields.desc: You can't see. All normal terrain is difficult terrain. Immune to visual effects.

fields.name: Broken
fields.desc: Object is damaged beyond normal function. Broken armor grants item bonus but impairs AC.

fields.name: Clumsy
fields.desc: Status penalty to DEX-based rolls and DCs equal to condition value.

fields.name: Concealed
fields.desc: Difficult to see. Target must pass DC 5 flat check to be affected by attacks.

fields.name: Confused
fields.desc: Attack wildly. Off-guard, no allies, can't Delay/Ready/reactions.

fields.name: Controlled
fields.desc: Will subverted. Controller dictates actions.

fields.name: Dazzled
fields.desc: All creatures and objects are concealed from you.

fields.name: Deafened
fields.desc: Can't hear. Auto-fail Perception requiring hearing. DC 5 flat check for auditory actions.

fields.name: Doomed
fields.desc: Dying value at which you die is reduced by doomed value.

fields.name: Drained
fields.desc: Status penalty to CON-based rolls. Lose HP equal to level times drained value.

fields.name: Dying
fields.desc: At death's door. Recovery check each turn. Die at dying 4.

fields.name: Encumbered
fields.desc: Clumsy 1 and 10-foot speed penalty.

fields.name: Enfeebled
fields.desc: Status penalty to STR-based rolls and DCs equal to condition value.

fields.name: Fascinated
fields.desc: -2 to Perception and skill checks. Can't use concentrate actions unrelated to fascination source.

fields.name: Fatigued
fields.desc: -1 to AC and saves. Can't use exploration activities.

fields.name: Fleeing
fields.desc: Must flee from source. Can't Delay or Ready.

fields.name: Frightened
fields.desc: Status penalty equal to value to all checks and DCs. Decreases by 1 each turn.

fields.name: Grabbed
fields.desc: Off-guard and immobilized. DC 5 flat check for manipulate actions.

fields.name: Hidden
fields.desc: Creature knows your space but not precise location. DC 11 flat check to target.

fields.name: Immobilized
fields.desc: Can't use move actions.

fields.name: Invisible
fields.desc: Undetected to everyone. Creatures must Seek to detect you.

fields.name: Off-Guard
fields.desc: -2 circumstance penalty to AC.

fields.name: Paralyzed
fields.desc: Frozen in place. Off-guard, can only Recall Knowledge.

fields.name: Prone
fields.desc: Off-guard, -2 to attacks. Only Crawl and Stand to move.

fields.name: Quickened
fields.desc: Gain 1 additional action at start of turn.

fields.name: Restrained
fields.desc: Off-guard, immobilized, can only Escape or Force Open.

fields.name: Sickened
fields.desc: Status penalty equal to value. Can't willingly ingest. Retch to recover.

fields.name: Slowed
fields.desc: Lose actions equal to slowed value.

fields.name: Stunned
fields.desc: Can't act. Lose actions equal to stunned value.

fields.name: Stupefied
fields.desc: Status penalty to INT/WIS/CHA rolls. Spells disrupted unless flat check passed.

fields.name: Unconscious
fields.desc: Can't act. -4 to AC/Perception/Reflex. Blinded and off-guard.

fields.name: Wounded
fields.desc: Dying value increases by wounded value when you gain dying.
